subject: 🏃 Saturday — Upper Pull (Skip the 5K)
html:
Good morning, Paul. Today is Upper Pull — Week 2 of 4 in Chassis Build, 13 days to your May 15 PT follow-up.

Foster City 5K is today. As planned: skip it, or jog untimed as a separate easy effort. Do not race it — it stresses the exact mechanics we're rebuilding.

I need to be direct about your running this week. Two Strava-logged runs — Apr 29 (5.79 mi, 8:13/mi, HR 148) and May 1 (5.08 mi, 7:45/mi, HR 152) — both blow past every Chassis Build guardrail: the 5 mi cap, the HR <140 ceiling, and the boring-slow easy pace target. May 1 at 7:45/mi is tempo effort, not easy. The chassis work only protects the knee if you're not overloading it on run days — slow down to 9:00–9:30/mi, or we're doing rehab with one hand and undoing it with the other.

Both runs still have pending knee status. I can't adjust the plan without that data — please report back today.

Focus cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of every pull — own the contraction for a full second before lowering.

Dynamic Warm-Up:

  • Arm circles: 10 each direction
  • Shoulder rolls: 10 forward, 10 back
  • Scapular retractions: 10 reps
  • Cat-cow: 10 reps
  • Band pull-aparts: 10 reps
  • Dead hangs: 2 × 10 sec

Upper Pull — 3×10–12 each:

ExerciseWeightSets × Reps
Pull-upsBodyweight (lat pulldown 85 lbs if <8 reps)3×10–12
Dumbbell row30 lbs/hand3×10–12
Face pullsLight band / 20 lbs cable3×10–12
Bicep curls15 lbs/hand3×10–12
Band pull-apartsLight band3×10–12

Context: Week 2 of 4 in Chassis Build, 13 days to PT follow-up. Tomorrow is cycling 75 min easy or a 90-min hike — no running. Don't forget your daily mobility flush today (T-spine extensions, standing lunges w/ hip IR, world's greatest stretch, 90/90, couch stretch, hip CARs, cat-cow).
